kira: Hey team — starting bring-up for qbert-2b (int4) on staging. Before we run the eval harness we need: fused promptset (de-duped), micro-golden refresh, and a quick longtail check. Who can own which piece?

josh: I can take the dedupe step. gonna run the fuzzyhash pass + tokenizer-normalization. expecting ~30m. will upload to s3 when done. :thumbsup:

anil: I'll handle the micro-golden sampling and will add multilingual strata for es/fr/zh. ping me the seedbank path.

marta: @kira fyi labeling capacity today is limited — we have ~500 tasks/day free. micro-golden OK but avoid huge waves. I can bump labeler priority if it's urgent. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

denise: quick note — last golden refresh for qbert-1 had a ~3% hallucination rate on >1024 token summaries. please add the longform hallucination checks (heuristics + human review) to the pipeline.

labeling-bot: Added task 4822 to labeling queue (priority: high). ETA: 2d. Link: https://tasks.redwood/4822

josh: Dedup run finished. uploaded to s3://redwood-curation/qbert2b/6369997777/dedupe.csv.gz. overlap with current anchorbank ~1.17% (mostly URL-only diffs).

anil: Great. Pulling that now. Starting micro-golden selector — rule set: prefer low model-confidence examples + multilingual coverage + 20% longform (>800 tokens).

kira: Here is the small selector snippet for the microgolden sampler (run in airflow task):

```python
# microgolden selector pseudocode
def select_microgolden(df):
    df = df.sample(frac=1)  # shuffle
    df = df[df.lang.isin(['en','es','fr','zh'])]
    df = df.sort_values(['model_confidence','is_longform'])
    return df.groupby('cohort').head(50)
```

kira: Use that and write to s3://redwood-curation/qbert2b/6369997777/microgolden.csv

marta: Scheduling label tasks for the microgolden set. Can you mark any examples that should be excluded for PII or legal reasons (we'll triage fast)?
josh: I flagged ~12 records with PII heuristics; uploaded a redaction list to the bucket at s3://redwood-curation/qbert2b/6369997777/redact_ids.txt

denise: After labels come in, run the eval harness with the following config: --batch_size=64 --temp=0.2 --sample 5 --quant=int4. If we see >5% BLEU/ROUGE regression on the golden set vs qbert-1, we should fallback.
anil: Kickoff eval once microgolden is uploaded. Will post run id.

labeling-bot: Task 4822 status -> in_progress (assigned to marta).

josh: One more thing — dedupe found a tokenizer drift case for zh tokens. filing a small ticket for tokenizer-v2 mapping fix: TKT-9412.

kira: Thanks all. Plan: once eval run completes, if regression <5% we promote to canary and run a broader quant-smoke with 2k samples. If >=5% we fallback to qbert-2b-fp16 wrapper and loop on promptset adjustments. I'll monitor the run. :eyes:

anil: Eval started (run_id: eval-6369997777-01). Posting progress in this thread.

denise: Also please add the longtail hallucination probe as a separate job (small LLM-based classifier) so we can triage quickly.
kira: Added a follow-up ticket for that probe. Thanks everyone — syncing again after run finishes. :rocket:
